said: I want to run twice a week and lift 3 times a week. I'm prepping for a marathon but I want to have weights and strength to help me. Build me a 7 week program for this
say: Here's the strength side to back up your marathon training. Each day builds real leg and hip strength with moderate volume so your legs stay fresh for running, plus trunk work and upper body pushing and pulling to keep you sturdy over 7 weeks.

said: half marathon in 12 weeks. I run 4 days and want to lift twice, upper body only, my legs get enough from the running
say: Since your legs are covered by the running, both days stay upper body only, built around pressing and pulling strength. Day one leads with bench and overhead pressing, day two leads with rows and pull-ups, so you get balanced push-pull volume across the week.

said: 5k plan, run 3 days and lift 2 days at home, I have dumbbells and a bench
say: Two full-body strength days to back up your running. Day one leads with squats and a hinge, day two leads with lunges and a bridge, and each day rounds out with pressing, rowing, and core work.

said: marathon training, 3 runs, 3 lifts. only ONE of the lifting days should have legs, the other two are upper body
say: Legs live on one day so your running stays fresh, and the other two are all upper body for pushing, pulling, and shoulders. Trunk work is folded in throughout to help you hold form late in your runs.
